violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. - Observed: the person in charge (PIC) is not a certified food manager (CFM).
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. - Corrective actions: PIC will need to obtain a CFM certificate within 10 calendar days.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' - Observed: the PIC is not able to present signed copies of “employee illness reporting agreement”.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. - Corrective actions: EHS provided extra copies for food employees to read and sign.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. - Observed: no handwashing signage at the hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. - Corrective actions: please provide a handwashing signage within 10 calendar days.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. - Observed: two kinds of residential pesticides were stored in dry storage cabinet.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. - Corrective actions: PIC will remove the residential pesticides.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. - Observed: bleach test kits were expired one year ago.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit within 10 calendar days.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the 3-compartment sink piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. BAILEY'S CHILDCARE & LEARNING (Inspection Date: 10/19/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Ceasing Operations & Reporting (Voluntary for Imminent Health Hazard)
violations.observation: The permit holder failed to discontinue operations and notify the Health Department that an imminent health hazard may exist because of an emergency. OBSERVED UNCONTROLLED COCKROACH INFESTATION DURING INSPECTION. OBSERVED COCKROACHES IN THE FOLLOWING AREAS DURING INSPECTION: - SEVERAL BABY COCKROACHES FELL INTO INSPECTOR’S HAND WHEN LIFTING PAPER OFF THE WALL. SEVERAL MORE COCKROACHES REMAINED ON THE WALL. - OBSERVED COCKROACHES ON WALLS AND CRAWLING TO CLOSET. - OBSERVED BABY COCKROACHES ON THE FLOOR. - OBSERVED MULTIPLE COCKROACHES UNDER CLEAN DISHES/DRY PADS. - OBSERVED DEAD COCKROACH IN RICE BAG ON RICE. - OBSERVED DEAD COCKROACHES IN BOOK CLOSET/SHELVING.
violations.corrective_action: CDI: FACILITY SELF-CLOSED DURING INSPECTION. FACILITY UNDERSTANDS THEY MAY NOT SERVE, PREPARE, STORE FOOD, OR CONDUCT ANY OTHER FOOD OPERATIONS DURING THE TIME THAT THEY ARE CLOSED. FACILITY WILL ORDER IN FOOD FOR THE CHILDREN/WORKERS TODAY AND WILL BE CLOSED FOR HOLIDAY TOMORROW. FACILITY IS AWARE THEY MUST DO THE FOLLOWING BEFORE THEY REOPEN: -GET AN EMERGENCY PEST CONTROL SERVICE BY A LICENSED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR. INVOICE SHOULD INDICATE FACILITY, AT MINIMUM, WAS TREATED FOR COCKROACH INFESTATION. -CLEAN ALL AREAS OF KITCHEN LISTED ON REPORT. ALL AREAS SHOULD BE FREE OF COCKROACH DROPPINGS AND BODIES. -SEAL ALL GAPS AND HOLES IN SMALL DISHWASHING/HANDWASHING ROOM. -MAKE AN EFFORT TO INSTALL CEILING TILES IN THE GAPS IN THE CEILING. -RID THE KITCHEN AND KITCHEN CLOSET OF ALL ITEMS THAT ARE NOT USED IN THE FOOD OPERATIONS. -[inspector], OR ANOTHER REPRESENTATIVE OF FAIRFAX COUNTY HEALTH DEPARTMENT, MUST CONDUCT A FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION AND APPROVE FACILITY TO RE-OPEN. YOU MAY CONTACT ME AT: 571-310-9072

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Eliminate Harborage Conditions
violations.observation: Harborage conditions exist. OBSERVED ITEMS IN KITCHEN CLOSET AND KITCHEN THAT ARE NOT RELEVANT TO THE FOOD OPERATIONS.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Eliminate harborage conditions to control and prevent the presence of pests on the premises. PLEASE REMOVE ALL ITEMS THAT ARE NOT IN USE INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO DISHWARE (NOT USED), DRYING MATS, ITEMS IN CLOSET, ITEMS IN BUCKET UNDER OVEN TABLE.

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: OBSERVED DEAD COCKROACHES INSIDE BOOK CABINET IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. BOOKS AND BOOK CABINET MUST BE CLEANED.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED MISSING CEILING TILES IN KITCHEN AND IN KITCHEN CLOSET. OBSERVED HOLES AND GAPS ALONG THE WALLS AND PLUMBING IN THE KITCHEN. OBSERVED UNSEALED WOOD IN DISHWASHING/HANDWASHING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. FILL ANY GAPS IN WALLS, FLOORS, AND CEILING TO HELP WITH THE PEST INFESTATION. INSTALL CEILING TILES INTO GAPS IN CEILING IN KITCHEN. TILES SHOULD BE EASILY CLEANABLE (VINYL). THE CEILING IN KITCHEN CLOSET SHOULD BE SEALED. PAINT WOOD IN WASHING AREA.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED COCKROACHES AND COCKROACH DROPPINGS IN THE FOLLOWING AREAS/SURFACES: -ON “UNUSED” DISHES ON SHELVING IN WASHING AREA. -ON SHELVING IN WASHING AREA. -ON THE SINKS AND PLUMBING FIXTURES -ON WALLS AND/UNDER POSTERS -INSIDE BOOK CABINET AND ON BOOKS -ON THE FLOOR
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CLEAN ALL AREAS LISTED ABOVE AND ANY OTHER AREAS ON WHICH COCKROACHES OR COCKROACH DROPPINGS WERE FOUND.
